learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to grasp the content of political geography and geopolitics.
Students will have general knowledge about the geography of Turkey.
Students will be able to establish a relationship between regional and global political events affecting and concerning Turkey and Turkey's various geographical features.
Students will be able to identify the geographical foundations of Turkey's effectiveness and power in international relations.
Students will be able to interpret the problems arising from current political events confronting Turkey, based on its geographical characteristics, in the context of our country's interests.

syllabus_topics: Turkey's position according to latitudes and longitudes in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's position according to land and seas in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's position according to economic unions and economic power centers in the world in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's position according to political unions and political power centers in the world in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's position according to world cultural regions in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's climate and vegetation in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's Geomorphology (landforms) in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's population in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's economy in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Turkey's economy in terms of international political power, effectiveness, and relations
Analysis of current regional and global political events concerning Turkey.
